versions.name: Camp McClintock
versions.summary: A Cherokee Area Council camp of roughly 240 acres in the Osage Hills west of Bartlesville, Oklahoma, with woods, cliffs, creeks, and ponds supporting year-round weekend and troop camping, plus a dining hall, pavilion, and cabin.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Cherokee Area Council (#469) camp page at cherokeebsa.org. The source labeled this an Indian Nations Council camp; it is a Cherokee Area Council property. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
